clientObjectives.text: Claudia wants to diversify beyond listed markets and invest in the real economy.
Her investment horizon is 15 years or longer.

riskProfile.text: Her risk profile is risk class 6, which matches the product risk indicator SRI 6.
She understands that returns are not guaranteed.

knowledgeAndExperience.text: The questionnaire states no private equity experience.
An earlier RM note records that she was an angel investor and sold a startup stake. The RM should confirm which statement is correct.

financialSituationAndLossCapacity.text: She holds €900,000 with us and states investable wealth of €3,000,000, including bank deposits of €1,400,000.
After this investment, private markets would make up 6.7% of her stated investable wealth.
She can bear a loss of the committed amount without affecting her plans.

whyTheProductFits.text: Meridian Buyout V matches her wish to diversify into private companies and her long horizon.
A commitment of €200,000 meets the fund minimum and fits her capacity to lock money for the fund term of 10 years.

risksExplained.text: Capital is locked for about ten years and capital calls come over three to four years.
The J-curve was explained: the fund is likely to show a loss in its first years.
Distributions are not guaranteed, and she could lose part or all of the committed amount.
The costs were explained; see the cost disclosure.

alternativesConsidered.text: An ELTIF with a lower minimum and no capital calls was discussed. Claudia prefers the buyout fund.

clientMessage.subject: Summary of our conversation on private markets
clientMessage.body: Dear Claudia, thank you for our conversation. Attached are the suitability statement and the cost disclosure for Meridian Buyout V. Please read both before you sign. Your commitment would be €200,000, with a first capital call of €40,000 at first close. If anything is unclear, just reply here. Best, Jonas

Proposed: Meridian Buyout V, commitment €200,000. ELTIF discussed as alternative. Open: clarify private equity experience before RM attestation.
openPoints: Clarify private equity experience: the questionnaire says none, an RM note mentions angel investing.
